readerContract.humanQuestion: What changed this week beyond the alarming headlines, and which changes affect the tools, schools and institutions around me?
readerContract.promisedPayoff: Distinguish a proposed safeguard, signed but opt-in protections, reported misuse and a consumer product rollout.
readerContract.priorKnowledge: No frontier-model, threat-intelligence or voice-model background assumed.
readerContract.centralMentalModel: Ask what changed, who it covers and what evidence would show it works. Different stories need different proof.
readerContract.dailyLifeConnection: A parent can ask about the school’s exact AI contract; a shopper can recognize a sponsored conversation; someone using voice tools can check the result.
readerContract.surfaceJob: September16 Weekly covering September9–16, with selective synthesis rather than every Daily story repeated.
readerContract.desiredFeeling: I can follow the big news without confusing a proposal with a protection already in place.
readerContract.desiredReaderFeeling: Informed and able to ask a specific question without technical training.

draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: Safety calls grew louder while school contracts and consumer tools changed in more specific ways.
causalSequence: A proposal names a safeguard but does not establish it is operating
A signed agreement protects only the products and schools inside its scope
A rollout changes what a user can encounter, while source evidence defines the limits
draftArchitecture.workedCase: A parent asks whether a school’s particular product and contract include the new privacy protections.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: A shopper notices a sponsored conversation is a seller’s channel and checks the product terms.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Ask who or what is covered before assuming a reassuring headline applies.
draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: Compare with prior Weekly; lead with the safety proposal and actual misuse report; move to specific school protections and everyday product changes.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: Unequal sections by consequence, no equal-length news catalogue or false claim that one development caused the others.
